## Mova 1.9.1

Mova 1.9.1 让扫描跳过那些从来不是媒体的文件和目录。以前只要扩展名是视频，任何文件都会入库并去 TMDB 刮削：macOS 的 `._xxx.mkv` 元数据文件、群晖的 `#recycle` 和 `@eaDir`、威联通的 `@Recycle`、Windows 的 `$RECYCLE.BIN`，以及放在正片旁边的预告片和样片，都会变成电影或剧集条目，回收站里已经删掉的片子还一直留在库里。

现在扫描按名称直接跳过这些条目，不读取、不探测、不计数，目录也不进入：以 `.` 开头的文件和目录；`#recycle`、`#snapshot`、`@eaDir`、`@Recycle`、`@Recently-Snapshot`、`$RECYCLE.BIN`、`System Volume Information`、`lost+found`、`extras`、`trailers`、`samples`、`sample`、`featurettes`、`behind the scenes`、`deleted scenes`、`interviews` 目录（不区分大小写）；`Thumbs.db` 和 `desktop.ini`；主文件名为 `sample`、`trailer` 或以 `-sample`、`-trailer`、`.sample`、`.trailer` 结尾的视频。媒体库根目录本身不受限制。创建媒体库时选择文件夹也不再显示这些目录。

升级后请注意：旧版本已经从这类路径入库的条目会在下一次扫描中删除，连同它们的播放进度和已看记录，即使文件仍然存在。本版本不修改公开 HTTP/SSE 契约，不包含数据库迁移，不要求重建缓存；只需照常扫描一次。

---

## Mova 1.9.1

Mova 1.9.1 makes scans skip files and folders that are never media. Previously any file with a video extension was catalogued and scraped against TMDB: macOS `._xxx.mkv` metadata files, Synology `#recycle` and `@eaDir`, QNAP `@Recycle`, Windows `$RECYCLE.BIN`, and the trailers and samples shipped next to a main video all became movie or episode entries, and a film deleted into the recycle bin stayed in the library.

Scans now skip these entries by name without reading, probing or counting them, and never enter the folders: files and folders starting with `.`; the folders `#recycle`, `#snapshot`, `@eaDir`, `@Recycle`, `@Recently-Snapshot`, `$RECYCLE.BIN`, `System Volume Information`, `lost+found`, `extras`, `trailers`, `samples`, `sample`, `featurettes`, `behind the scenes`, `deleted scenes` and `interviews` (case-insensitive); `Thumbs.db` and `desktop.ini`; and videos whose name without extension is `sample` or `trailer` or ends with `-sample`, `-trailer`, `.sample` or `.trailer`. The library root itself is exempt. The folder picker used when creating a library leaves these folders out as well.

After upgrading, entries an earlier version catalogued from such paths are removed on the next scan, together with their playback progress and watched state, even while the files still exist. This release does not change the public HTTP or SSE contract, contains no database migration and requires no cache rebuild; a normal scan is enough.
